description: Group A field family: psi (PSI) for one numeric feature, reference window vs current window. Formula: 10 equal-frequency bins on reference deciles, bin proportions floored at 1e-4, PSI = sum((actual_pct - expected_pct) * ln(actual_pct/expected_pct)). Bin edges are the reference sample's decile boundaries (indices round(i*n/10) for i=1..9); the last bin is closed on both ends to include the max value.
